decision_context.topic_seed: privacy controls for family finance apps
decision_context.audience: US parents managing shared family budgets
decision_context.monitoring_intent: initial review snapshot for product-shell integration

source_coverage.coverage_boundary: Public discussion evidence only; not a representative market sample.

cluster_seed.headline: Families ask for clearer permission boundaries
cluster_seed.summary: Multiple public discussions describe confusion about who can see transactions, edit budgets, or invite household members.

confidence.label: directional
confidence.boundary: Directional because the evidence is public discussion only and not a measured population sample.

caveats: The cited discussions do not prove willingness to switch tools.
The evidence does not cover non-public support tickets or interviews.
review_entries.next_validation_hint: Compare role and permission language across two more public community sources.

cluster_seed.headline: Shared-account users mention audit history gaps
cluster_seed.summary: A smaller set of comments asks for clearer logs when household members make budget or category changes.

confidence.label: exploratory
confidence.boundary: Exploratory because corroboration is limited and the comments may reflect power-user workflows.

caveats: Audit-history language appears less frequently than permission-boundary language.
review_entries.next_validation_hint: Look for independent mentions of edit history, accountability, or household change logs.

evidence_items.title: Thread about family budget app permissions
evidence_items.summary: A public thread describes confusion when a partner can see sensitive spending categories but cannot tell which role controls that visibility.
evidence_items.quote_excerpt: I want a way to separate what my partner can edit from what they can only view.
evidence_items.provenance_note: Public URL retained; raw thread payload is not included in the handoff.

evidence_items.title: Comments on a family finance setup video
evidence_items.summary: Several comments ask whether children or partners can have read-only access without changing shared categories.
evidence_items.quote_excerpt: Can my spouse view everything but my teen only see allowance categories?
evidence_items.provenance_note: Public comment context is summarized; raw comment export is not included.

evidence_items.title: Thread about shared budget edit history
evidence_items.summary: A user describes difficulty understanding who changed a budget category in a shared household account.
evidence_items.quote_excerpt: I need to know who changed a category before the month closed.
evidence_items.provenance_note: Public source reference is retained as a URL only.

limitations: This review snapshot is based on bounded public-source evidence.
The handoff does not include raw traces, raw source payloads, or scoring internals.
Review order is a boundary-level triage order, not a market score.
